item: R844 (row 449): link density is a corroborating signal only and can never disqualify a source alone
refs: PR pending; row 449; R844; R850; R851
summary: The field analysis (#2418) found link_density_rate alone disqualifying about 100 mainstream outlets per re-checking instance: an extraction-failure criterion with no floor, read by derive_status as degraded, which decide_verdict maps to disqualified. The criterion is now marked corroborates_only: derive_status reads the signature by criterion name without it, so alone or with soft signals only it is watch (qualified), and beside the pathology signature it still makes a source failing. Its evidence guard and flag record are unchanged; a stored failing list from before is judged by the new rule. The sources panel marks it 'corroborates only' with a hover (2 keys x12) and no longer as able to disqualify. CRITERIA_VERSION moves to oo-source-qualification-4, a label only: nothing re-judges on it, so the sources it disqualified come back at their normal re-check cadence. R850/R851: the disqualified sources whose only failing extraction criterion, recomputed read-only from their stored articles with the re-check's own flag_criteria, is link density are chosen once per install inside a pass (label: chosen by recomputing from stored articles; fewer than 5 stored articles = not determined, left on the ladder) and made due ONCE through select_due_disqualified, so the ordinary pass judges them with its own consent, transport, pacing and per-host limits and nothing runs while qualification is off; the chosen go first only within the pass's own re-check budget, and the ones a pass does not reach stay chosen. The recompute reads 50 sources at a time at a pass's own history cap and, after a memory pause, waits a day before it is asked again. The qualification queue shows the counts (re-checked of chosen, not determined; 3 keys x12). The marker lives in app_state, which a merge restore never adopts, so a backup from another install cannot mark this one's selection done. No stage bump, no re-extraction, no schema change.
